title: openagents chat send waits forever on a task whose process died
body:
From the #10209 study (docs/cost/2026-10-02-shadow-baseline-measurement.md, de33359b99): on the shipped path, routed Claude cost 1.68× raw Claude Code. Part of #10204.

During the study, `chat send` kept waiting on tasks whose owner process had died, with no error. Detect a dead owner (task store disposition / pid liveness, like the issue flow's 'owner process ended') and end the wait with a plain message.
